cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll talk about last night's rent argument, but not the whole year tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It does. One question, and let me finish before you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer for a minute.
